title: Record detail page inline edit: a row-conditioned field lock (`when`) still disables the field on every row — the detail page does not ask the record projection the edit dialog now asks
body:
Filing gate: ① the card's own symptom, left on one surface. Residual of #26594 after PR #27137 (contract review 6463995320, flag 2; the dev's os-dev-report lists it as an out-of-scope finding with no issue). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and the grade (the ui lane is suggested).

**Symptom.** On the record detail page, inline edit still reads the row-blind field lock. A field permission `when` that locks a field only from some state onward (hotclm `clm_finance`: legal fields from `approved` on) shows the field locked on a draft row the write gate admits, the same symptom #26594 reported for the edit dialog.

**Where.** `ui/packages/plugin-detail` `DetailSection.tsx` (around line 507) and `HeaderHighlight.tsx` (around line 211) resolve the lock through `resolveFieldAffordance('recordEdit', …)` → `checkField(object, field, 'write')`, which is `/auth/me/permissions`' answer and holds no row. PR #27137 wraps the edit dialog, edit page and drawer form in `RecordFieldAccessScope`, which replaces that lock with the server's record projection (`GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/field-access`, #27063); the detail page is not wrapped.

**Expected.** The detail page holds one row, so its inline edit can ask the same record projection the edit dialog asks (ruling 6457467702, letter B: the server's answer, never a client `when` evaluator), and a conditioned lock disables a field only on rows it names.

**Declared limitation, not this card.** The list view's inline edit locks a whole column, and one column lock cannot split per row; it may keep the row-blind answer. Say so where that surface is documented.

**Dedupe.** `search_issues` on this repo (open): "inline edit when lock" returned #26594 (the source) and #27138 (row write scope, a different gap); "\"recordEdit\" OR \"plugin-detail\" field lock" returned no card on this surface (#26594, #26891, #26843, #26888 and unrelated sweeps). **New.**
